name: Keeper
summary: Keeper sells Business Starter (for 5 to 10 users), Business and Enterprise plans, billed annually. Its pricing page does not show per-user prices. Single sign-on (SAML), SCIM and AD/LDAP provisioning are listed on Enterprise. Advanced Reporting and Alerts and Compliance Reporting are add-ons, with no prices shown.

facts.text: Keeper states that its government platform holds FedRAMP High and GovRAMP High authorization and runs in AWS GovCloud (US).
Keeper's encryption is FIPS 140-3 validated, with NIST certificate 4743.
Keeper describes itself as HIPAA compliant and says it is not a Business Associate, so it does not sign business associate agreements.
Advanced provisioning on Enterprise includes SCIM, AD/LDAP and SSO/SAML.
The Business and Enterprise plans include a free Keeper Family Plan for up to 5 family members for each user.
